Subject: Need help with a land dispute case

Hello, my name is Leena Patil. I am a 65-year-old shopkeeper living in Bengaluru. I have a land dispute with Shruti Apte over land worth INR 64,70,000/-, and the neighbour has encroached on the boundary of the plot. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 64423 64166 or email leena.patil@example.com.
